items.stem: What does Charles say songs can do when he sings them?

choices.text: Touch his heart.
choices.zh: 触动他的心灵。

choices.text: Make him cry.
choices.zh: 让他哭泣。

choices.text: Remind him of his life.
choices.zh: 让他想起自己的人生。

choices.text: Make him feel young.
choices.zh: 让他感觉年轻。

items.stem: What does Charles say about himself as a singer?

choices.text: He is good at singing operas.
choices.zh: 他擅长唱歌剧。

choices.text: He enjoys complicated music.
choices.zh: 他喜欢复杂的音乐。

choices.text: He can sing any song if he likes it.
choices.zh: 如果他喜欢一首歌，他就能唱任何歌。

choices.text: He loves country music in particular.
choices.zh: 他特别喜爱乡村音乐。

items.stem: What's one of the man's weaknesses?

choices.text: He can't do such a complicated piece of music as the opera.
choices.zh: 他无法演唱像歌剧这样复杂的音乐作品。

choices.text: He can't sing a song that he doesn't like.
choices.zh: 他无法唱他不喜欢的歌。

choices.text: He can't concentrate on his singing sometimes.
choices.zh: 他有时无法专注于自己的演唱。

choices.text: He can't play musical instrument while singing.
choices.zh: 他无法边唱歌边演奏乐器。

items.stem: What will Charles do when his personal life is hurting?

choices.text: Go to a bar and drink for hours.
choices.zh: 去酒吧喝上几个小时。

choices.text: Go to an isolated place to sing blues.
choices.zh: 去一个与世隔绝的地方唱布鲁斯。

choices.text: Go to see a performance in a concert hall.
choices.zh: 去音乐厅看演出。

choices.text: Go to work and wrap himself up in music.
choices.zh: 去工作并让自己沉浸在音乐中。

items.stem: What does the woman want to know about the man?

choices.text: How he became an announcer.
choices.zh: 他是如何成为一名播音员的。

choices.text: How he writes news stories.
choices.zh: 他是如何撰写新闻报道的。

choices.text: How he makes his living.
choices.zh: 他是如何谋生的。

choices.text: How he does his job.
choices.zh: 他是如何完成工作的。

items.stem: What does the man say news subs do?

choices.text: They write the first version of news stories.
choices.zh: 他们撰写新闻报道的初稿。

choices.text: They gather news stories on the spot.
choices.zh: 他们在现场采集新闻。

choices.text: They polish incoming news stories.
choices.zh: 他们润色收到的新闻稿件。

choices.text: They write comments on major news stories.
choices.zh: 他们撰写重大新闻的评论。

items.stem: What does the man say is a big challenge for him?

choices.text: Reading through the news stories in a given period of time.
choices.zh: 在规定时间内通读新闻稿件。

choices.text: Having little time to read the news before going on the air.
choices.zh: 播出前几乎没有时间阅读新闻。

choices.text: Having to change the tone of his voice from time to time.
choices.zh: 不时地改变声音的语调。

choices.text: Getting all the words and phrases pronounced correctly.
choices.zh: 将所有的词语和短语都准确发音。

items.stem: What role does the man say his small cross plays?

choices.text: It shows where advertisements come in.
choices.zh: 它标示广告插入的位置。

choices.text: It gives a signal for him to slow down.
choices.zh: 它给他发出放慢速度的信号。

choices.text: It alerts him to something important.
choices.zh: 它提醒他注意重要内容。

choices.text: It serves as a reminder of sad news.
choices.zh: 它作为悲伤新闻的提示标记。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about America's universities?

choices.text: They offer students a wide variety of courses.
choices.zh: 它们为学生提供种类繁多的课程。

choices.text: They attract students from all over the world.
choices.zh: 它们吸引来自世界各地的学生。

choices.text: They admit more students than they can handle.
choices.zh: 它们招收的学生超过了其承受能力。

choices.text: They have trouble dealing with overseas students.
choices.zh: 它们在应对海外学生方面存在困难。

items.stem: What is Americans' view on education according to Prof. Marvin Bresler?

choices.text: Everyone will benefit from education sooner or later.
choices.zh: 每个人迟早都会从教育中受益。

choices.text: A good education contributes to the prosperity of a nation.
choices.zh: 良好的教育有助于国家的繁荣。

choices.text: A good education is necessary for one to climb the social ladder.
choices.zh: 良好的教育是一个人攀登社会阶梯的必要条件。

choices.text: Everyone has a right to an education appropriate to his potential.
choices.zh: 每个人都有权接受与其潜力相适应的教育。

items.stem: What do we learn from Prof. Christopher Ricks' remark?

choices.text: He likes students with high motivation.
choices.zh: 他喜欢有高度积极性的学生。

choices.text: He enjoys teaching intelligent students.
choices.zh: 他喜欢教聪明的学生。

choices.text: He tailors his teaching to students' needs.
choices.zh: 他根据学生的需求调整自己的教学。

choices.text: He treats all his students in a fair manner.
choices.zh: 他以公平的方式对待所有学生。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about energy used in the United States?

choices.text: It is mostly imported from the Middle East.
choices.zh: 大部分从中东进口。

choices.text: It is a sure indicator of its economic activity.
choices.zh: 是其经济活动的可靠指标。

choices.text: It has a direct impact on the international oil market.
choices.zh: 对国际石油市场有直接影响。

choices.text: It equals more than 30 million barrels of oil each day.
choices.zh: 相当于每天超过3000万桶石油。

items.stem: What do scientists say about energy contained in fuel?

choices.text: It eventually turns into heat.
choices.zh: 最终转化为热量。

choices.text: It is used in a variety of forms.
choices.zh: 以多种形式被使用。

choices.text: Its use is chiefly responsible for air pollution.
choices.zh: 其使用是造成空气污染的主要原因。

choices.text: Part of it is lost in the process of transmission.
choices.zh: 在传输过程中有一部分损失掉了。

items.stem: When does mass transit prove superior to private vehicles?

choices.text: When it is used in rural areas.
choices.zh: 在农村地区使用时。

choices.text: When it is environment-friendly.
choices.zh: 环保时。

choices.text: When it operates at near capacity.
choices.zh: 在接近满载运行时。

choices.text: When it operates at regular times.
choices.zh: 在固定时间运行时。

items.stem: What seems to be the speaker's biggest concern?

choices.text: Traffic jams in cities.
choices.zh: 城市交通拥堵。

choices.text: Inefficient use of energy.
choices.zh: 能源使用效率低下。

choices.text: Fuel shortage.
choices.zh: 燃料短缺。

choices.text: Global warming.
choices.zh: 全球变暖。

items.stem: Which of the following is a mood-boosting habit according to Rubin?

choices.text: Smelling scented candles.
choices.zh: 闻香薰蜡烛。

choices.text: Setting an alarm for waking up.
choices.zh: 设置起床闹钟。

choices.text: Talking with your parents often.
choices.zh: 经常与父母交谈。

choices.text: Listening to an upsetting song.
choices.zh: 听一首令人沮丧的歌曲。

items.stem: What is "ONE-MINUTE RULE" according to the lecturer?

choices.text: Handle the overwhelming unopened mail and tiny tasks within one minute.
choices.zh: 在一分钟内处理堆积如山的未拆邮件和琐碎任务。

choices.text: Do anything that can be done in less than one minute without delay.
choices.zh: 毫不拖延地做任何能在一分钟内完成的事情。

choices.text: Do everything that can't be done in a minute within one minute.
choices.zh: 在一分钟内做所有无法在一分钟内完成的事情。

choices.text: Documents must be printed out and filed within one minute.
choices.zh: 文件必须在一分钟内打印出来并归档。

items.stem: What does "BRIGHT-LINE RULES" refer to?

choices.text: Strict habits.
choices.zh: 严格的习惯。

choices.text: Positive attitude.
choices.zh: 积极的态度。

choices.text: Hard rules.
choices.zh: 硬性规则。

choices.text: Decision-making methods.
choices.zh: 决策方法。

items.stem: What does "a person can never be too rich" mean according to the talk?

choices.text: It takes great pains for a person to be very rich.
choices.zh: 一个人要变得非常富有需要付出巨大的努力。

choices.text: Not Everyone wants to be too rich.
choices.zh: 并非每个人都想变得太富有。

choices.text: A person will never be satisfied with his wealth.
choices.zh: 一个人永远不会对自己的财富感到满足。

choices.text: A person will never have the feeling of being wealthy.
choices.zh: 一个人永远不会有富有的感觉。

items.stem: What's a person's purpose of saying "I am working for chickenfeed"?

choices.text: Introducing a topic.
choices.zh: 引入一个话题。

choices.text: Telling a joke.
choices.zh: 讲一个笑话。

choices.text: Making a complaint.
choices.zh: 进行抱怨。

choices.text: Making a decision.
choices.zh: 做出决定。

items.stem: What can we learn about the German spies in World War l, according to the talk?

choices.text: They were well paid by the German government.
choices.zh: 他们得到了德国政府的丰厚报酬。

choices.text: They gathered mostly in London during the war.
choices.zh: 战争期间他们大多聚集在伦敦。

choices.text: They didn't provide any valuable information for Germany.
choices.zh: 他们没有为德国提供任何有价值的情报。

choices.text: They worked for both their own country and their enemies.
choices.zh: 他们既为自己的国家工作,也为敌人工作。

items.stem: What is the talk mainly about?

choices.text: Some common chicken food in America.
choices.zh: 美国一些常见的鸡饲料。

choices.text: The living and working conditions of Americans.
choices.zh: 美国人的生活和工作条件。

choices.text: The German and British spies in World War Two.
choices.zh: 第二次世界大战中的德国和英国间谍。

choices.text: Some expressions related to money.
choices.zh: 一些与金钱有关的表达。

items.stem: Which of the following is the feature of a modern family?

choices.text: The husband is the head of the household.
choices.zh: 丈夫是一家之主。

choices.text: The husband usually makes big decisions.
choices.zh: 丈夫通常做重大决定。

choices.text: The wife lives within her husband's income.
choices.zh: 妻子在丈夫的收入范围内生活。

choices.text: The wife works and does two kinds of jobs.
choices.zh: 妻子工作并承担两种工作。

items.stem: Why were the school-age children of a traditional family more dependent?

choices.text: Their mother would help them to get ready for school and to make their breakfast.
choices.zh: 他们的母亲会帮助他们准备上学并做早餐。

choices.text: They had to help their mother and father to take care of their younger sisters and brothers.
choices.zh: 他们必须帮助父母照顾年幼的弟弟妹妹。

choices.text: Their mother had to get up early in the morning to drive them to school.
choices.zh: 他们的母亲必须一大早起床开车送他们上学。

choices.text: They were spoiled by their parents and didn't want to go to school.
choices.zh: 他们被父母宠坏了,不想去上学。

items.stem: Why is the American family today so different from that of fifty years ago?

choices.text: The roles of the father, mother, and children have changed.
choices.zh: 父亲、母亲和孩子的角色发生了变化。

choices.text: An increasing number of women work outside the home.
choices.zh: 越来越多的女性在外工作。

choices.text: Changes have taken place in the structure of an American family.
choices.zh: 美国家庭的结构发生了变化。

choices.text: The increasingly rapid pace of life makes people under greater pressure.
choices.zh: 日益加快的生活节奏使人们承受更大的压力。
